statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because fresh reporting shows mixed Asian equities rather than a confirmed one-way NQ path; oil near $107 and the 10-year yield near 5% keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The next evidence-heavy danger window is the 12:30Z Empire State release through the first full U.S. cash-session hour; stronger Tail states remain conditional on observed persistent extension or failed retracements.
headline: Tail stays low as Asia remains mixed; oil and near-5% yields keep Stress extreme
body: Fresh Reuters reporting shows Asian equities mixed, Brent near $107, and the U.S. 10-year yield just under 5%. No sufficiently current independent source verifies persistent one-way NQ structure. The shared Finviz context is older than 90 minutes and is not used as current supporting evidence.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock hours, Tail was elevated through Monday's overnight and early U.S. session, peaking at 32%, then fell as substantial intraday mean reversion emerged. It was WATCH at 16-17Z, low at 18-19Z, briefly WATCH again at 20Z, and remained low from 21Z through 02Z.
outlookSummary: Current Tail remains low because fresh reporting shows mixed Asian risk and no verified persistent one-way NQ path. Conditional risk rises into the 12:30Z Empire State release and 13:30Z cash open, peaking at 24% WATCH only if price discovery becomes persistently directional with shallow or failed retracements.
